# Joe Gibbs Politz

> Associate Professor of Teaching at UC San Diego CSE. Development co-lead of
> the Pyret programming language. I work on programming languages and
> computing education, design courses with reusable open materials, and build
> tools and languages for teaching programming.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jpolitz.github.io/): Courses, recent projects, and publications.
- [Contact](https://jpolitz.github.io/contact/): Email, office hours, and advising info.
- [Notes](https://jpolitz.github.io/notes/): Blog posts and longer write-ups.
